firm_data.firm_description: Stinson LLP provides practical legal guidance to clients ranging from individuals to privately-held enterprises to international corporations. They deliver extensive legal knowledge and stay close to their clients' businesses.
notable_facts: Stinson has 500 attorneys in 16 offices nationwide.
The firm is committed to diversity, equity & inclusion and supporting communities with pro bono.
Stinson uses Harvey AI to support attorneys across practice areas and enhance the delivery of legal services.
Stinson donates at least three percent of total billable hours to pro bono every year.

ai_contact.ai_notes: Stinson adopts Harvey AI firmwide to enhance client service and collaboration.

email.subject: AI for Stinson LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Shawn,

Stinson's adoption of Harvey AI firmwide to enhance client service across 500 attorneys in 16 offices tells me you're serious about staying competitive while managing complex operations at scale.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of mid-market practices: precision, client trust, and operational efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Midwest to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Kansas City office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
